scientific_source_commit_policy: The exact GitHub Actions execution commit is captured in pre_generation_freeze.json before the TxGraffiti call and in manifest.json after the call.
design_change_from_tf1: Only the TreeForge adapter interpretation of an empty hypothesis payload changes: [] is normalized to TxGraffiti None, meaning the always-true base predicate. Target, features, generators, heuristics and post-processors remain TF1-identical.

holdout_history.order_11: BURNED: TF1 holdout; excluded from TF2
holdout_history.order_12: Previously used only for invariant timing/feasibility benchmarking in TF1. No order-12 invariant table, candidate outcome, relation geometry, feature selection, method selection, or threshold tuning was inspected before TF2-0001 was frozen.

excluded_from_discovery.edge_count: calibration/consistency column; tree identity edge_count = order - 1
excluded_from_discovery.degree_sum: calibration/consistency column; handshake identity degree_sum = 2 edge_count
excluded_from_discovery.min_degree: constant 1 on the nontrivial-tree discovery universe
excluded_from_discovery.independence_number: not supplied alongside matching_number because alpha(T)+nu(T)=order for bipartite trees
excluded_from_discovery.radius: diagnosed discovery-side but deliberately not added; TF2 changes only adapter semantics
excluded_from_discovery.eccentricity_sum: diagnosed discovery-side but deliberately not added; TF2 changes only adapter semantics
excluded_from_discovery.wiener_index: diagnosed discovery-side but deliberately not added; TF2 changes only adapter semantics
excluded_from_discovery.cherry_count: diagnosed discovery-side but deliberately not added; TF2 changes only adapter semantics

txgraffiti.adapter_semantics: empty TreeForge payload means no additional predicate and is normalized to TxGraffiti's always-true base predicate

anti_numerology: explicit exclusion of definitional/calibration columns from TxGraffiti features
all engine outputs are preserved before human triage
candidate_cap_policy: NO_CAP; every post-heuristic/post-processor statement returned by the frozen adapter enters first-stage triage and receives a permanent ID

candidate_normalization.raw_preservation: preserve exact forall string emitted through the TreeForge adapter
candidate_normalization.structured_metadata: preserve hypothesis, lhs, operator, rhs, discovery touch count and discovery validity when exposed by the adapter
candidate_normalization.duplicate_equivalence: exact normalized (hypothesis,lhs,operator,rhs) equality is DUPLICATE; mathematically equivalent but differently oriented statements are linked and triaged explicitly rather than silently deleted

known_result_artifact_filters: definitions and immediate algebraic consequences of supplied columns
holdout_sealing: Before TxGraffiti is invoked, order-12 rows are generated only to verify count, exact identities and SHA-256. Only count/hash are persisted in pre_generation_freeze.json; rows are then discarded and are never supplied to the generator or used for triage.
mutation_policy: Any material change after this freeze closes TF2-0001 and requires a new experiment ID. No holdout outcome may be used to tune generation, normalization or preference.
